title: XXII: The Procession

teacherSummary.text: The procession passes; Dimmesdale walks with strange energy and seems far from Hester. Mistress Hibbins tells Hester she knows the minister's secret. Hester stands by the scaffold listening to the sermon's tone through the meetinghouse walls. Pearl brings the captain's message: Chillingworth will bring the minister aboard.
